stats.text:
As a {ref:glossary/utilize} action, you can use Manacles to bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the {ref:condition/grappled}, {ref:condition/incapacitated}, or {ref:condition/restrained} condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. While bound, a creature has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on attack rolls, and the creature is {ref:condition/restrained} if the Manacles are attached to a chain or hook that is fixed in place. Escaping the Manacles requires a successful DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as an action. Bursting them requires a successful DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.

Each set of Manacles comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use {ref:equipment/thieves-tools} to pick the Manacles' lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.
